name: CertiChain
description: Issues a digital certificate and lets anyone check it from a public link. name: FINAL-YEAR-PROJECT-
description: Holds PipelineIQ, a simulated study of machine-learning bottleneck detection in CI/CD pipelines plus a Streamlit dashboard. name: SyncSound
description: Coordinates one YouTube video across separate phones so each phone plays locally into headphones already paired with it. A host shares a room code, link, or QR code. Playback is a scheduled start plus drift correction, and audio never passes through the server. The current build is a Vite client and a single-process FastAPI server that stores rooms in memory and in SQLite.

name: BULLPAY
description: Self-hosted checkout for one Indian merchant. The customer pays in a normal UPI app and the rupees land in the merchant’s own UPI ID. BULLPAY does not hold a balance or call a bank or NPCI API. It marks a checkout paid only when a bank credit alert matches that open session. The README says it is experimental software and not an RBI-licensed payment product.
readmeSummary: BULLPAY is experimental software. It is not a bank. It is not an NPCI-approved or RBI-licensed payment aggregator. It is not affiliated with any bank or UPI app. A browser event is only for the shop’s user interface. The merchant fulfills an order only after verifying the signed webhook, and still reconciles SUCCESS against the bank statement. A missing or delayed SMS can leave a real payment unmatched.
